description: Commit pages whose filters or ordering need replacement resolution (outcome, last_attempt_outcome, or sorting by ended_at, outcome or rerun_number) previously read every retained run with FINAL, which a job filter cannot prune. They now read FINAL only at the test starts holding more than one stored row and every other row directly through by_job, as the statistics do. before = the full-FINAL SQL the builders generated before the change; after = working-tree SQL. The test-route and by_job commit SQL are recorded under unchanged and must stay byte-identical.

fixture.note: Commit with 9,984,566 stored rows across 1,006 jobs and 28 shared test starts (56 rows) at measurement time; the test is one with a failed execution. Fixtures expire under the 14-day TTL.

before.sql:
WITH (
    SELECT groupArray(id)
    FROM default.workflow_job
    WHERE run_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM default.workflow_run
        WHERE id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_head_sha
            WHERE head_sha = {sha: String}
        )
            AND head_sha = {sha: String}
            AND repository.full_name = {repo: String}
    )
) AS matched_job_ids
SELECT
    toString(run.tests_id) AS tests_id_string,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS environments_id_string,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id_string,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id_string,
    toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(run.started_at)) AS sort_0,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS sort_1,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS sort_2,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS sort_3,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS sort_4
FROM (
    SELECT run.tests_id AS tests_id,
        run.environments_id AS environments_id,
        run.env_vars_id AS env_vars_id,
        run.github_workflow_job_id AS github_workflow_job_id,
        min(run.started_at) AS started_at
    FROM ci.runs AS run FINAL
    WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
    GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.environments_id, run.env_vars_id, run.github_workflow_job_id
    HAVING countIf(run.outcome IN {outcome: Array(String)}) > 0
) AS run
WHERE 1
    AND (1)
ORDER BY run.started_at DESC, run.tests_id ASC, run.environments_id ASC, run.env_vars_id ASC, run.github_workflow_job_id ASC
LIMIT {entries_limit: UInt64}

    )
) AS matched_job_ids
SELECT
    toString(run.tests_id) AS tests_id_string,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS environments_id_string,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id_string,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id_string,
    toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(run.started_at)) AS sort_0,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS sort_1,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS sort_2,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS sort_3,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS sort_4
FROM (
    SELECT run.tests_id AS tests_id,
        run.environments_id AS environments_id,
        run.env_vars_id AS env_vars_id,
        run.github_workflow_job_id AS github_workflow_job_id,
        min(run.started_at) AS started_at
    FROM ci.runs AS run
    WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
    GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.environments_id, run.env_vars_id, run.github_workflow_job_id
    
) AS run
WHERE 1
    AND (1)
ORDER BY run.started_at DESC, run.tests_id ASC, run.environments_id ASC, run.env_vars_id ASC, run.github_workflow_job_id ASC
LIMIT {entries_limit: UInt64}
SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 0

WITH (
    SELECT groupArray(id)
    FROM default.workflow_job
    WHERE run_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM default.workflow_run
        WHERE id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_head_sha
            WHERE head_sha = {sha: String}
        )
            AND head_sha = {sha: String}
            AND repository.full_name = {repo: String}
    )
) AS matched_job_ids,
(
    SELECT [(
        groupArrayIf(job_test, stored_rows > 1),
        [
            countIf(stored_rows = 1),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'unknown'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'passed'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'failed'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'error'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'skipped'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'xfailed'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'xpassed'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'crashed'),
            countIf(stored_rows = 1 AND outcome = 'timed_out')
        ]
    )]
    FROM (
        SELECT (run.github_workflow_job_id, run.tests_id) AS job_test,
            count() AS stored_rows,
            any(run.outcome) AS outcome
        FROM ci.runs AS run
        WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
        GROUP BY run.github_workflow_job_id, run.tests_id
    )
) AS classified_keys,
(SELECT tupleElement(arrayJoin(classified_keys), 1)) AS multi_row_keys,
(SELECT tupleElement(arrayJoin(classified_keys), 2)) AS stored_once
SELECT stored_once[1] + count() AS total,
    stored_once[2] + countIf(final_outcome = 'unknown') AS unknown,
    stored_once[3] + countIf(final_outcome = 'passed') AS passed,
    stored_once[4] + countIf(final_outcome = 'failed') AS failed,
    stored_once[5] + countIf(final_outcome = 'error') AS error,
    stored_once[6] + countIf(final_outcome = 'skipped') AS skipped,
    stored_once[7] + countIf(final_outcome = 'xfailed') AS xfailed,
    stored_once[8] + countIf(final_outcome = 'xpassed') AS xpassed,
    stored_once[9] + countIf(final_outcome = 'crashed') AS crashed,
    stored_once[10] + countIf(final_outcome = 'timed_out') AS timed_out
FROM (
    SELECT argMax(run.outcome, (run.outcome != 'skipped', run.started_at, run.ended_at, toString(run.id))) AS final_outcome
    FROM (
        SELECT any(run.tests_id) AS tests_id, any(run.environments_id) AS environments_id, any(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id, any(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id, any(run.started_at) AS started_at, any(run.ended_at) AS ended_at, any(run.id) AS id, any(run.outcome) AS outcome
        FROM ci.runs AS run
        WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
            AND (run.github_workflow_job_id, run.tests_id) IN (SELECT arrayJoin(multi_row_keys))
        GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.started_at
        HAVING count() = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT run.tests_id AS tests_id, run.environments_id AS environments_id, run.env_vars_id AS env_vars_id, run.github_workflow_job_id AS github_workflow_job_id, run.started_at AS started_at, run.ended_at AS ended_at, run.id AS id, run.outcome AS outcome
        FROM ci.runs AS run FINAL
        PREWHERE (run.tests_id, run.started_at) IN (SELECT run.tests_id, run.started_at
            FROM ci.runs AS run
            WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
            AND (run.github_workflow_job_id, run.tests_id) IN (SELECT arrayJoin(multi_row_keys))
            GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.started_at
            HAVING count() > 1)
        WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
            AND (run.github_workflow_job_id, run.tests_id) IN (SELECT arrayJoin(multi_row_keys))
    ) AS run
    GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.environments_id, run.env_vars_id, run.github_workflow_job_id
)
SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 0
